description: Seller: rate (1 to 5) and review the buyer of one of your orders. Writes to the chain: this prepares an unsigned transaction (an intent) for `signer`; nothing happens until you sign it with geode-local-signer and submit it with geode_submit_intent.

rating.description: Non-negative integer as a string of digits

review.description: UTF-8 text, at most 2048 bytes; no control or invisible characters

signer.description: Your account address (SS58). The transaction is prepared for this account; you sign it on your own machine with geode-local-signer.

name: geode_market_rate_a_buyer
title: Market: rate a buyer
